packageRules.description: Major bumps require human review — breaking changes possible
Group routine cargo updates to keep PR noise down
Group action SHA bumps — pinDigests keeps these flowing
Security fixes jump the PR queue. prPriority is ONLY valid inside packageRules — this is the fleet-standard placement (see srv-*/renovate.json).

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Bypass routine schedule and grouping — CVE patches ship within an hour of advisory publication, auto-merged on green CI. prPriority does NOT belong here: Renovate rejects it under vulnerabilityAlerts and it is the cause of the 'Found renovate config warnings' badge. It lives in packageRules below, matched via isVulnerabilityAlert.
